title: FFmpeg Lite 1.0.0
release_notes:
• FFmpeg Lite is the mobile-first edition: every tool you see is one the phone's FFmpeg build actually supports
• Instant lossless stream-copy for cut/trim, join and dossier remux — no re-encode required
• Extract audio (AAC/M4A/FLAC/WAV), frames and palette-optimized GIFs
• Audio Studio: two-pass LUFS mastering (YouTube/Podcast/Broadcast presets), channel routing and resampling
• Filter stack: crop, scale, rotate, speed, volume, denoise, sharpen and PNG watermark — measured against your device's build
• Live local HTTP stream recording with stop-keeps-output; HTTPS streams download through the app's own network stack
• Media dossier: streams, codecs, bitrates, rotation, chapters and a shareable report
• Serial job queue with per-job progress, pause/resume, cancel and a persistent banner
• Capture camera photo/video and microphone audio straight into the pipeline
• Safe-area layout for notched and gesture-nav phones, plus Android system back that returns in-app
• Before/after preview, audio player and swipe-undo history
